items.summary: Maintain containment and authorize no incremental spend, prototypes, monetization claims, or new implementation this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 57 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, and 7 repair follow-ups. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0 and the aggregate cannot be assigned to a site. Revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift are unsupported. September AI spend is $997.51762695 across 5,522 calls, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors; approximately $0.18065 per call, but cost-to-learn and cost per conversion are not calculable. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z, then release one slot for the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. Measure registered affiliate clicks only; baseline is 61 clicks for 2026-09-21. Do not claim orders, commission, margin, ROI, or causal lift without named site-level revenue and comparable exposure/outcome evidence.

After capacity release, permit only the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. Preserve the registered destination, tracking ID, and disclosure. Measure registered affiliate clicks for 14 days or 100 relevant impressions. Minimum evidence for financial claims is a provider export with site tracking ID, dates, clicks, orders, shipped items, and commission; current aggregate provider rows remain explicitly unattributed.

Known portfolio evidence is 14,734 impressions, 150 clicks, 1,021 sessions, and 17 conversions across the SEO snapshot, but these metrics are not linked to attributable revenue or incremental cost. Contribution margin cannot be calculated because fixed infrastructure, labor, domain, marketing, and other operating costs are absent; AI cost alone is not contribution cost. Minimum additional measurement is monthly infrastructure/domain spend by site or fleet, labor hours or approved labor cost by change, marketing spend, and experiment-level exposure linked to attributable revenue.

items.requested_action: Produce one timestamped finance baseline from existing authoritative snapshots, explicitly separating known values from unavailable values.
